stations.title: Ffion
stations.say: Why does it say sign in first?

stations.title: Studio app
stations.text: Signs in, then drops the cookie it got.

stations.title: Cupboard server
stations.text: Knows a presenter only by a session.

captions: Ffion signs in on the studio app to change tonight's playlist, and is told to sign in.
The server sets a cookie at sign-in, and the app never sends it back on the next request.
You bring cookies back, choose where they go, and set and trust a session, in four tasks.
Ffion's next request carries her session, and the server knows her from its own records.
A cookie carries a session id back. Only the server's own record says who someone is.
